description: Answer from the office: sends each permission request (and AskUserQuestion question) to the local JGENTS (port in JGENTS_PORT, default 4747) and waits up to 5 min for the answer (up to 24 h with JGENTS_PERMISSION_TIMEOUT); if JGENTS is down or no page is open, it exits at once and the terminal answers.

hooks.statusMessage: Waiting for an answer in JGENTS
